ontario-grade-9-10-science-tutoring/inde.heading: Grades 9–10: getting started
ontario-grade-9-10-science-tutoring/inde.beforeText: Every student begins with a free Meet & Greet to discuss their current course, learning needs and goals. Lessons are then designed around the individual student, supporting both immediate classroom learning and longer-term scientific understanding.
ontario-grade-9-10-science-tutoring/inde.text: Begin with a free Meet & Greet to discuss the student’s Science course, current questions and learning goals. Together, we can identify a useful starting point.

ontario-grade-11-12-biology-chemistry-tu.heading: A Meet & Greet for senior science
ontario-grade-11-12-biology-chemistry-tu.beforeText: Begin with a free Meet & Greet to discuss the student's course, current challenges and learning goals. Lessons are then tailored to their individual needs, whether they are building understanding of difficult concepts, strengthening analytical skills or developing greater confidence in Biology or Chemistry.
ontario-grade-11-12-biology-chemistry-tu.text: A free Meet & Greet gives us time to discuss the student’s Biology or Chemistry course and their goals for Grades 11 or 12. We can then consider the support that would be useful.
